name: Splitting Chunk
description: Times each chop to one full breath so qi runs from the legs to the falchion's edge as the cut falls.

name: Gust Hash
description: Closes distance with a gliding step while the qi in the legs and arms settles into a single line.

name: Nubhauberk
description: Holds the blade across the forearm and the breath in the chest to take a blow without giving ground.

name: Gusthew
description: Hacks low at the opponent's shin as the opponent steps in, stopping the advance with a sudden pain.

name: Heavyback Torment
description: Lets full-meridian qi flow into the curved belly as it is drawn across the target in a long pull.

name: Chime Clipedge
description: Steadies the arm with a surge of meridian qi and turns a heavy blow aside with the broad flat.

name: Might Falchhilt
description: Slides in along the line of a cleave, entering the opponent's reach just as the cut ends.

name: Sanguine Nubtip
description: Drives qi through every primary meridian into one falling stroke that cleaves through a raised guard.

name: Grinding Bulkblade
description: Chains cleaving cuts so that qi never leaves the blade between strokes, each fall following the last without pause.

name: Granite Wedgetip
description: Cuts once at a short distance to feel how far the qi field follows the blade.

name: Facetnub
description: Stands with the qi field spread wide around the body and the blade resting along the back.

name: Torrent Weightbelly
description: Pulls the body forward on the tug of the field so the step carries the blade's weight with it.

name: Mightnub
description: Beats out hack after hack on a steady count while the field around the blade holds an even shape.

name: Mantled Chopblade
description: Braces the free palm against the spine with the field flaring so the blade stops a heavy blow.

name: Might Cleaverbelly
description: Extends the field a hand's breadth beyond the point so the falling cut lands past the steel's reach.

name: Nubcuirass
description: Rolls the blade inside the field to scatter a thrust before it reaches the body.

name: Wrecking Thickspine
description: Throws a barrage of field-extended hacks that keeps the opponent pinned behind a guard.

name: Severing Thickspine
description: Releases the qi field from the blade at the end of the swing so the chop strikes a body beyond the edge.

name: Splitting Hew
description: Wraps the whole blade in the field and drives the clipped point forward to pierce through light armor.

name: Unflinching Wedgetip
description: Rests the spine on the shoulder and plants the feet so the blade forms a wall before the body.

name: Chopblade Greave
description: Scrapes the opponent's blade down the face of the wall guard and off to the side.

name: Hashassault
description: Answers a turned blow with a short chop at the opponent's shoulder while the guard is still raised.

name: Silt Chunk
description: Shifts half a step to one side without lowering the wall guard, changing the angle of the blade.

name: Thorn Bulkblade
description: Sets meridian qi along the flat and holds the wall guard against a rain of blows.

name: Scything Clipedge
description: Lets the wall guard collapse forward into a drop that lands on the opponent's weapon arm.

name: Cleaverbelly Greave
description: Raises a thick layer of qi along the broad flat that blunts a heavy blow before it reaches the blade.

name: Rumble Cleft
description: Releases the stored qi of the wall guard into a single chop that answers the blow it absorbed.

name: Waning Nubtip
description: Marks out the arc the blade will sweep and feels the field to see where the opponent stands in it.

name: Gustwhack
description: Swings the falchion level at waist height in a broad stroke that covers the whole front.

name: Rumblehew
description: Swings up and over the opponent's raised guard to cut at the head from the side.

name: Whack Jaunt
description: Takes a long pace in the direction of the sweep so the body's travel adds length to the cut.

name: Heavyback Cloak
description: Rolls the spine up in the return of a sweep to catch a cut aimed at the side.

name: Unbroken Thickspine
description: Holds the blade wide of the body at the end of a sweep, keeping the arc covered while the feet reset.

name: Needling Whack
description: Stretches the field out ahead of the sweeping edge so the cut reaches past the opponent's retreat.

name: Whackleap
description: Closes a wide gap in one sweeping lunge with the blade trailing out to the side.

name: Chimewhack
description: Holds the sweeping edge in the field to push several opposing weapons out of line at once.

name: Dismantling Hack
description: Throws the full qi field out along a great arc, cutting every opponent standing within the falchion's sweep.

name: Granite Hew
description: Sweeps out and hacks back along the same arc so two cuts land on the same line.

name: Nubtipelixir
description: Settles one stream of qi in the legs and one in the blade, feeling the two run side by side.

name: Annealed Weightbelly
description: Plants both feet as a pair so the leg stream and the blade stream support one another in the chop.

name: Ironchunk
description: Falls on two beats, a feint downward and then the true chop, the second beat landing the cut.

name: Silthack
description: Steps along two lines in turn, one foot advancing while the blade moves along the other.

name: Equipoise Clipedge
description: Parries with the flat on one beat and answers with the edge on the next.

name: Harpooning Hack
description: Sends the leg stream up through the hip into a drawn belly cut that gains its length from the step.

name: Chime Chunk
description: Sends the blade stream out against an incoming weapon, pressing it wide and opening the guard.

name: Grinding Hash
description: Cuts across the body on both tracks at once so the blade and the stepping foot arrive together.

name: Scything Heavyback
description: Joins the leg stream and the blade stream at the last instant of the fall into one heavy overhead chop.

name: Equipoise Falchhilt
description: Turns a heavy blow on the first beat and cleaves down through the opening on the second.

name: Thornnubtip
description: Holds the falchion high and back like a perched hawk's wing, ready to stoop at any opening.

name: Granite Chopblade
description: Lifts the blade high as if to fall in an overhead cut, drawing the opponent's guard upward.

name: Rupturing Cleaverbelly
description: Drops under the raised guard with a falling cut at the opponent's hip, following the feint.

name: Gust Cleft
description: Sweeps a step to the side with the blade held out like a wing to keep the opponent turning.

name: Equipoise Weightbelly
description: Parries twice in quick succession with the clipped tip and the belly, like the two talons closing.

name: Chime Falchhilt
description: Narrows the sight to the opponent's lead shoulder and reads the first move of the cut.

name: Granite Bulkblade
description: Joins the high feint and the stooping chop in one flowing motion with a pulse of qi in the arm.

name: Iron Weightbelly
description: Beats the blade like a wing across the front of the body, a pulse of qi catching each blow.

name: Hamstringing Whack
description: Closes the tip and the belly on the opponent's blade like talons and pins it for one beat.

name: Severing Wedgetip
description: Rises on the high feint and stoops in a diving chop that gathers all the field's weight into the blade.

name: Scalding Rumble Hash
description: Stoops twice from opposite sides in the same rhythm, so the second chop meets an opponent still turning.

name: Scything Hew
description: Holds the blade out in a wing and releases a sweep of the field that reaches those on either side.

name: Facetstump
description: Lowers the hips into a hollow stance with the blade curved before the body like a shallow basin.

name: Unshaken Bulkblade
description: Catches a cut in the hollow of the belly and rolls it off along the curve.

name: Rumble Heavyback
description: Hacks along the line of the guard's rim to strike the opponent's hand as the blow drains away.

name: Nubleap
description: Steps back by slow measures, gathering the opponent's pressure in the guard like water filling a basin.

name: Thornstump
description: Lets a heavy blow slide along the curved belly and pours the force into the ground.

name: Stumpcuirass
description: Bends the parry like a river around a stone, taking the opponent's cut wide and returning to guard.

name: Tempered Whack
description: Releases the gathered force of the basin guard in one falling chop when the hollow is full.

name: Thorn Clipedge
description: Gathers each blow taken on the curve into a store of qi that the guard holds ready to release.

name: Cleaving Might Cleft
description: Releases the whole store from the basin guard in a single cleave that falls with the weight of every blow absorbed.

name: Chime Wedgetip
description: Reads the opponent's field on one track while the other track keeps the blade's own field steady.

name: Rumblenub
description: Falls on the opponent's near shoulder with the edge glowing on the field's pale blue track.

name: Granite Hack
description: Crosses the stepping foot on the second track so the blade and body arrive from different sides.

name: Resilient Chopblade
description: Holds two linked guards, one over the brow and one at the hip, with the blade moving between them.

name: Blaze Thickspine
description: Runs the hack along the opponent's blade like a river along its bank, ending at the hand.

name: Might Hew
description: Pivots the lead heel in a basin curve, setting up a cut from a lower line.

name: Rumble Falchhilt
description: Runs the belly cut on both qi tracks so the drag and the weight arrive together.

name: Torrent Thickspine
description: Turns a blow with the flat on one track and prepares the answering cut on the other.

name: Paralyzing Cleaverbelly
description: Rolls the blade through a hawk-like turn that tears the opponent's guard open for the cleave.

name: Hewthrash
description: Lands two cleaves in the span of one, one on each track of the qi field, on the same line.

name: Shade Chunk
description: Presses the opponent from two sides of the field with alternating cleaves until no counter remains.

name: Charter Nubtip
description: Takes the wind-sworn stance with the blade held loose, the body ready to turn on the wind's shift.

name: Tearing Cleft
description: Sights along a fixed bearing and lets the falchion fall directly down that line onto the target.

name: Silt Nubtip
description: Advances with quick light steps that carry the blade forward with the push of a following wind.

name: Chime Weightbelly
description: Parries across the line of attack like a crosswind, pushing the opposing blade off its bearing.

name: Veritystump
description: Takes a bearing on the opponent's body by the feel of the qi in the air between the two.

name: Blazenub
description: Holds the bearing steady through the opponent's feints and chops the moment the line opens.

name: Racing Whack
description: Turns suddenly on the heel as a gale shifts, putting the blade on a fresh bearing in one step.

name: Whacktorment
description: Lets the falchion fall along a sworn bearing with qi carried straight from the legs to the edge.

name: Cleaving Wedgetip
description: Shifts the bearing mid-stroke on a turn of the wrist so the cleave lands where the guard has left.

name: Nubplating
description: Plants the feet flat as on a high plateau, leaving no ground for the opponent to push the body from.

name: Drubbing Nubtip
description: Speaks the oath in a short breath as the blade falls, steadying the field around the hack.

name: Soaring Cleft
description: Steps along the line of a plateau's edge, keeping the opponent to the open side.

name: Chime Heavyback
description: Holds the guard unbroken through the oath's whole breath, turning each cut off the steady blade.

name: Needling Hack
description: Beats out chops at the rhythm of the sworn oath, each fall matching a word.

name: Iron Hash
description: Holds the qi field motionless around the blade for the whole length of the fall.

name: Chimestump
description: Parries like a wind coming over a plateau, sweeping the blow wide with no resistance.

name: Hackhauberk
description: Cuts through the rhythm of the opponent's attack at the exact count of the oath's pause.

name: Lambasting Bulkblade
description: Brings the falchion down with the whole oath's weight held in the field, cleaving where the blade is aimed.

name: Scything Hack
description: Drives the clipped point forward under a steady field and pushes through guard and mail alike.

name: Aegisnubtip
description: Opens the guard by turning the blade in a slow circle before the body like a rising gale.

name: Enduring Clipedge
description: Catches an incoming cut on the whirling flat and carries it around in the circle.

name: Rumble Chunk
description: Drops a chop at the end of the whirl, the spin of the guard adding speed to the fall.

name: Granite Cleaverbelly
description: Steps away on the turn of the guard so the body leaves as the opposing blow arrives.

name: Immovable Cleaverbelly
description: Scatters a blow with a backhand parry on the spinning blade and keeps the turn moving.

name: Granite Nubtip
description: Drops the whirl low at the knee to cover the legs while the upper body shifts out of line.

name: Murk Heavyback
description: Whirls the falchion in a circle fed by qi so that several cuts are turned in succession.

name: Blazehew
description: Releases the whirl into a hack that comes round the guard and strikes where the opponent has turned.

name: Rumble Chopblade
description: Spins the blade round the opponent's weapon and snatches it from the hand with a gale-like pull.

name: Facet Bulkblade
description: Spins the falchion so fast the qi forms a wall around the body that turns blows and missiles alike.

name: Skinning Wedgetip
description: Releases the whirl's stored momentum in a single great cleave from the side.

name: Stumpbarrage
description: Releases a gale-wide sweep of the blade that cuts every opponent inside the falchion's turning reach.

name: Thorn Weightbelly
description: Fixes the stance on a chosen bearing so the blade can rise and fall along it without wandering.

name: Blazewhack
description: Chops along the bearing with plenty of room in front, the body's weight following the blade.

name: Blurring Hash
description: Sets each foot down as lightly as a gust, so the advance gives no warning of the chop.

name: Gust Falchhilt
description: Parries the opponent's cut across its own line and breaks the opponent's bearing.

name: Tempered Hack
description: Holds the field along the bearing so the cut stays true even when the opponent twists away.

name: Racing Hash
description: Reverses direction like a gale shifting and brings the blade round onto a new bearing.

name: Thickspine Assault
description: Holds the bearing until the opponent commits, then turns like a gale and cleaves along the new line.

name: Ponderous Falchhilt
description: Presses forward across open ground with turning cleaves that leave the opponent no bearing of their own.
